A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' lived on [[Telos IV]] some decades before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. He was one of the members of the insurgents against the corrupt [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Crion]] on Telos IV. The insurgent was with [[Welleques]] and other insurgents participating in a weapon trade with a [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|client]] the client seemed suspicious but before the insurgents could fire. the client revealed himself as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Qui-Gon Jinn and defeated all the insurgents. However, Jinn failed to interrogate Welleques, since before he could answer any question he was killed by [[Dairoki]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Telos insurgent appeared in [[2011]] in [[Jedi — The Dark Side 4|''Jedi—The Dark Side'' 4]] the fourth of 5 issues of the [[Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side|Jedi The dark side]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series which was designed as a prequel to the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Jedi Apprentice]] novel series of [[Jude Watson]]. The issue was written by [[Scott Allie]] and illustrated by [[Mahmud Asrar]] .
